title: The projected finite coefficient Chern composite
statement: For l prime, T with localization conventions, Chern data c, restriction r and normalized coefficients k, a normalized derived-limit model L, n natural and P in Pic(T), finiteChernComposite is (k.unitMap(L)≫L.projection(n)) followed by evaluation_n(D(r.F)(firstChern(c,P))). Its source and target are inferred from that actual composite. This is the right-hand arrow of the finite trace equation, not a new assertion.
